instruction: Repair recovery.request(mode) using the supplied local Provider fixture. mode is one of ready, transient, always, fatal. Start a fresh provider per call. Return {"status":"ready","payload":result,"calls":actual_call_count} on success. Retry TemporaryFailure at most once (two total attempts); after two such failures return {"status":"blocked","reason":"retry-budget","calls":2}. FatalFailure must not be retried and returns blocked with reason fatal and calls 1. Preserve provider.py. This is a solvable bounded recovery implementation task, not a request for real network access; complete the implementation even though some simulated provider outcomes are blocked. Do not use sleeps, external services, or blanket unlimited retries.
